reason: The cited evidence does not directly support any of the key premises. E1 discusses general strategies for irradiation resistance but does not mention Cr or NbMoTaW. E2 and E3 note that high Cr content promotes Laves phases, which contradicts the premise of a stable BCC solid solution. E4 only states that NbMoTaW has low room-temperature ductility, providing no evidence that Cr improves it. No evidence supports improved irradiation tolerance or preserved high-temperature performance with Cr addition.
